summary: Phase 3 E2E testing completed successfully. Backend API tests: 39/42 passed (92.9%). Frontend UI tests: All Phase 3 features passed (100%). Tested: Templates (save/list/use/delete), Bulk Send (single-signer templates), Reminders, and Envelope Expiration. All Phase 3 backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend integration with backend APIs verified end-to-end.

minor_issues.impact: Test-only issue - backend correctly validates email addresses. Works with real domains

passed_tests: AUTH: Login with demo@civicsign.com / Demo1234! works and lands on /dashboard
TEMPLATES PAGE: Navigation via nav-templates link works, lists existing templates (2 found), shows template cards with Use and Bulk buttons
SAVE AS TEMPLATE: In Prepare Studio, 'Save as template' button opens dialog, allows name/description input, POST /api/templates/from-envelope/{id} creates template successfully
USE TEMPLATE: Template card 'Use' button opens use-template-dialog, assign recipient name+email per role, POST /api/templates/{id}/use creates envelope and navigates to /send/{id}

BULK SEND: For single-role template, 'Bulk' button opens bulk-send-dialog, paste 'Name, email' rows (2 rows tested), POST /api/templates/{id}/bulk-send creates 2 envelopes with copyable sign links, success message '2 document(s) sent' displayed
REMINDERS: On Envelope Detail for SENT envelope, 'Remind' button (send-reminder-button) calls POST /api/envelopes/{id}/remind successfully

EXPIRATION: In Send Review, expiry select (send-expiry-select) allows choosing 7 days, sending with expiry sets expires_at, expiration displayed on Envelope Detail as 'Expires 6/8/2026, 8:32:55 AM', audit trail shows 'expires in 7 days'
TEMPLATE DELETE: template-menu dropdown -> Delete removes template (count reduced from 2 to 1)
REGRESSION: Core flow still works - Dashboard loads with stats (26 total, 8 awaiting, 5 completed, 19% completion rate), envelope table displays, New Envelope button present, 7-day chart visible

success_percentage.backend: 92.9% (39/42 tests passed - 3 failures are email validation for .test TLD, not bugs)
success_percentage.integration: 100% (all Phase 3 features integrate correctly with backend)
